items.quote: Most people follow up once. Maybe twice. Then they give up.
items.statement: Winners follow up with purpose: • Immediate: "Thanks for the call" • 1 week: Relevant market update • 1 month: Success story from similar client • 3 months: "How's the baby/project/situation you mentioned?" • 6 months: New opportunity that fits their timeline.

items.quote: The fortune is in the follow-up.
items.statement: Your follow-up game determines your income game.

overview: LinkedIn post outlining a follow-up strategy for sales success.
